title: Coordinated Follow-Up Office Visit Copay
content:
**Medicaid Managed Care Membership — care transitions terms: coordinated follow-up office visits**

When primary care office visits are re-rated as preventive or coordinated care, an in-person follow-up office visit is rated by whether the care team reached the member for a transition follow-up. The visits are read from the primary care visit logs (Primary Care Provider Assignment) and the calls from the Care Management contact records, both over the 12-month office re-rating window counted back from the review date (a date counts when it lies fewer than 12 whole months before the review date).

## Terms

An in-person follow-up office visit — a visit logged with visit type follow-up and visit mode in person, dated in the window — re-rates at:

- **0.00 USD**, the reached coordinated follow-up copay, where the care team recorded a reached transition follow-up call in the window;
- **1.00 USD**, the unreached coordinated follow-up copay, where it recorded none.

With no in-person follow-up logged, nothing is re-rated under these terms.

## Input, judgement, result

| In-person follow-ups logged in the window | Reached transition follow-up call recorded in the window | Re-rated copay |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | At least one | 0.00 for each in-person follow-up |
| One or more | None (no call, or only calls with another outcome) | 1.00 for each in-person follow-up |
| None | Either | Nothing re-rated under these terms |

## Hypothetical cases

Inputs chosen for illustration only.

- Two in-person follow-ups logged 2 and 5 months before the review date; Care Management shows a transition follow-up call 4 months back with outcome reached. Both visits re-rate at 0.00.
- Same visits; the only transition follow-up call in the window was not reached. Both re-rate at 1.00.
- A telehealth follow-up is logged but no in-person follow-up: nothing is re-rated under these terms.
